freight.summary: No free shipping on Access4U. Freight is charged at actual cost, based on each order's size and weight, and is confirmed by HCPS on your order.
freight.actualNote: Access4U freight is charged at actual cost (order size and weight) and confirmed by HCPS on your order — there is no free shipping.

freight.summary: Wheelchairs, ErgoSteel and the SEATA rollator ship free. Accessories add one $15 shipping & handling charge per order, whatever the number of accessories.
Actual shipping charges apply to all orders.
freight.actualNote: Actual shipping charges apply to all orders.

freight.label: BongoRx standard shipping
freight.summary: Free standard shipping on orders with 10 or more Bongo Rx kits, replenishment packs or single replenishment units (mix and match). Replacement headgear does not count toward the 10, but ships free in a qualifying order. Below 10, actual standard shipping applies.
freight.actualNote: Below 10 qualifying Bongo Rx units: actual standard shipping is added from the confirmed order — no flat amount is quoted.

freight.summary: Free freight on all Climbing Steps orders.

Delivery charges per item from Corsicana's 2026 price list: merchandise under $2,500 ships UPS/FedEx; $2,500 or more ships LTL. An item with its own or included delivery charge keeps it. Freight Corsicana lists as TBD (CorsicanaCare Bed Booster) is pending until Corsicana's order confirmation. White Glove delivery is available on select items — request it in your notes.

Volume pricing applies to the combined quantity of an item across its sizes. Freight is calculated and confirmed by HCPS on your order (Ovation's standard shipping terms — update here if free-freight thresholds apply).
freight.actualNote: Freight is confirmed by HCPS on your order confirmation.

freight.summary: Prepaid freight on orders of $500 or more; $40 shipping & handling on orders under $500.
Free freight on orders $200+. Orders under $50 add a $5 freight fee; $50–$200 ships at standard freight.
freight.actualNote: Standard freight is confirmed by HCPS/PediFix on your order.
